fixed_plan.profile_scope: whole timed proxy lifetime: startup, readiness, warmup, timed load, and teardown

normalization.cpu: sampled CPU nanoseconds per one million warmup-plus-timed completions
normalization.allocation: cumulative allocated bytes and objects per warmup-plus-timed completion

limitations: diagnostic-only two-arm sequential observation with no repetitions or release-gate claim
whole-lifetime profiles include startup, readiness, idle, and teardown work outside request handling
heap alloc_space is cumulative and the heap profile is emitted at normal process exit
production event persistence and native intentional omissions make the arms intentionally non-equivalent
completion normalization is a scale aid, not a causal per-request cost measurement
